deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for best funding consideration; complete applications are due January 15, 2027 (the catalog lists January 5, 2027 for the PhD).
deadline.quote: The preferred deadline is December 15, 2026, for best consideration for financial support. | the deadline for Fall 2027 complete applications, including all transcripts, letters, test scores, and statements, is January 15, 2027

gre_subject.value: No subject test exists for this field.

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is optional.

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement is mentioned.

funding.value: All PhD students get at least a minimum stipend, with support renewed on satisfactory progress; top entrants get a first-year fellowship (about $40K).
funding.quote: All Ph.D. students are supported at a minimum stipend level.

also.quote: The department is committed to supporting PhD students for the duration of their studies.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in science or engineering, including Calculus I and Differential Equations.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the Graduate Program in Bioengineering requires a bachelor’s degree in a science or engineering discipline from an accredited undergraduate institution.
